import json
import sys
from pathlib import Path

repo = Path.cwd()
sys.path.insert(0, str(repo / "src"))

from do_again.service.daemon import _drain_browser_outbox, _pending_outbox
from do_again.service.runtime import runtime_layout

layout = runtime_layout(repo)
state = layout.state_dir

before = [p.name for p in _pending_outbox(state)]
delivered = _drain_browser_outbox(repo, state)
after = [p.name for p in _pending_outbox(state)]

print(json.dumps({
    "before_count": len(before),
    "before": before,
    "delivered": delivered,
    "after_count": len(after),
    "after": after,
}, indent=2))

raise SystemExit(0 if not after else 1)
